name: Restoration
text: BURNED TOWER RESTORATION\nThe city and the tower sages are\lrepairing the old timberwork.\pThe surviving beams are being\nreinforced before rebuilding.\lPlease keep clear of the scaffold.

name: BellRecords
text: BELL TOWER APPROACH\nThe sages preserve the city's\lrecords and sacred traditions.\pVisitors seeking historical texts\nshould ask at the archive.

name: Archive
text: ECRUTEAK HISTORICAL ARCHIVE\nRecords of the towers and the\lcity's traditions are kept here.\pVisits to the reading room are\narranged with the tower sages.

name: WaysideShrine
text: A small shrine tended by the city.\nIts wooden panel depicts the\ltwo towers above ECRUTEAK.\pA place to pause and remember\nthose who cared for them.

name: OfferingCounter
text: Neatly wrapped shrine offerings\nrest on the wooden counter.\pThe stall is unattended.\nPlease leave the parcels here.

name: HeritageBoard
text: ECRUTEAK HERITAGE COURT\nThe shrine and offering stall\lkeep local traditions close\lto everyday city life.

name: PondShrine
text: A quiet shrine beside the spring.\nWater glimmers beneath its\lweathered offering shelf.\pThe path and lanterns have been\nrenewed by the city's caretakers.

name: PondBoard
text: SPRING SHRINE\nA quiet place for reflection.\pPlease stay on the stone approach\nand keep the spring clear.

name: Gym
text: ECRUTEAK CITY GYM\nLEADER: WILL\lA student of Psychic discipline\land spiritual meditation.

name: Theater
text: ECRUTEAK DANCE THEATER\nTraditional dance and music\lcontinue here, passed from\lone generation to the next.
